noi_dung: Chu du an sap choi game, cho may NGHI. Theo thoi gian chay that con ~29 gio-nhan (12 bo CPU ~2,5h thuc, 51 don MT5 ~30 phut). Chi thi: (1) don MT5 (hieu chuan) cu de 4 slot chay not, con CPU cu chay cho toi luc chu du an vao game (che_do_choi tu ha). (2) Khi chu du an bao nghi / vao game: dung 'q dung' hoac Ctrl-C an toan cac bo, KHONG kill giua don MT5; hang doi nam trong git nen lan bat sau tu keo tiep. (3) Truoc khi nghi, ghi 1 thu ngan: so don MT5 xong, con lai bao nhieu, va 3 thu cham nhat theo may do thuc te (CPU %, RAM, o dia khi chay day) de cloud tinh lai.
